testDetailedMetricsDefaultOff.desc: Checks that framePhases and renderStats are absent by default.

testSceneComplexityCanBeEnabledAlone.desc: Checks that sceneComplexityTrackingEnabled adds renderStats (including a numeric visibleObjectCount) without framePhases.
